name: Bahnstrecke Nürnberg-Würzburg
description:
Wind your way around the low peaks of Bavaria on thrilling long-distance and speedy regional services; varied action awaits along Bahnstrecke Nürnberg - Würzburg in Train Sim World 7! Venture through valleys aboard continental commuter units and ICE traffic galore on a scenic sprint from city to city.

Built as a shortcut to bypass the lengthy Ludwig South-North & West railways, the new line via Neustadt (Aisch) opened to traffic in 1865. Despite a reluctant state interest in the line’s existence, it quickly became one of the busiest lines in Germany, and has seen many upgrades to become the regional, intercity and freight corridor it is today.

In Train Sim World 7, become a driver or conductor on busy Deustche Bahn services. Climb aboard unique continental commuter units for regional express workings, shuttle between towns and cities on the Nürnberg S-Bahn’s S6 line, or swap it all for cool and classic ICE traction, running non-stop, but keeping it real with varied signals and speed limits. For a further twist, vector in-between the passenger flow with modern Vectron power on varied freight operations.
